answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 15573 Country: India Title: if any hafiz quran cuts his bear and he wants to do taraveeh in the month of ramdan in front of listeners so pls tell me what should he do read the quran or leave? Question: if any hafiz quran cuts his bear and he wants to do taraveeh in the month of ramdan in front of listeners so pls tell me what should he do read the quran or leave? Answer ID: 15573 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1371/1371=M/1430) He should leave cutting the beard and should repent to Allah seeking His forgiveness. Once his beard is more than one fist, he can lead tarawih etc; otherwise his imamah (leading prayer) will be makrooh tahrimi . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
